overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on either allegation: the July 9 wetlands regulation topic was sufficiently specific, and posting an inaccessible notice to the Town website was not required since the website is not the official posting location.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the July 9 notice topic on proposed wetlands bylaw regulation changes was too vague because it omitted the actual proposed language, fee amounts, or a summary of changes.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to the sufficiency of this topic.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission violated the law by posting the July 9 notice to the Town website only as an image-only PDF, not a machine-readable, accessible version.
allegations.key_passage: Where the Town has not adopted its website as its official notice posting location, the Commission was not required to post the meeting notice to the Town’s website.
